hypothesis: A conventional exact-content-addressed 256-float factual key/value cache will be a competent stronger control than an undertrained sequence GRU, and the original-equation 256-float learned fast-weight write gate may or may not outperform it on unseen actual simulated action consequences.

source.stream: per-world random orthogonal 16D causal action basis; independent continuous 16D effect map; 8 target keys repeated and 16/48 singletons, uniformly interleaved; fresh action and observed effect emitted for each executed simulated action; no role/time or future query in online input
source.actual_observations: Factual action plus observed consequence only; one actual simulated final target action queried only after all prior updates
source.novelty: P68 seeds independent of P65/P66/P67; no prior source reuse or sealed first-use claim
source.ood: unfamiliar per-world mapping, 80 versus 64 events, four versus six target presentations, tripled distractors; new source seed and same readout procedure
source.negative: orthogonal distractors cannot affect all-write target prediction; separately wrong-credit test

candidates.learned_gate: Unchanged P67 four-parameter sigmoid feature gate: bias, log residual MSE, log prediction energy and cosine alignment; P65 16x16 outer-product factual matrix with eta 0.5; train from fresh nonzero independent seeds
candidates.all_write: Same factual outer-product update with gate=1; no learning; 256 fast state floats
candidates.frequency_cache: Conventional associative memory with eight 16D action keys and eight 16D observed effect values = 256 floats; keys encode observed hit count in norm without separate counter, cosine lookup by key, similarity threshold 0.98, update values by online mean, otherwise insert into weakest free/replacement slot; never access role labels, future query or time-index feature; deterministic tie order
candidates.simple_cache: Same 256-float slot store with no frequency weighting: on miss cyclic replace; same query rule
candidates.zero: Zero predictor (per-target variance) against which competence is measured
candidates.oracle: Role-aware oracle diagnostic ONLY, forbidden for main comparison

train.checkpoint: select minimum validation MSE only, no OOD-tuning
train.capacity: State exactly 256 floats for learned matrix and both slot memories; count encoded in key norm; compare measured process wall time and trainable parameter counts; no FLOP equality claim

gates.source_and_leakage: Role fractions over 4 position bins within 0.05 of global prevalence, and held-out index-only BALANCED accuracy <=0.55 on FIT, VAL, OOD-DEV; count memory-float budget exactly
gates.independent_seed_initialization: Three distinct gate theta SHA256 values
gates.cache_competence: Frequency cache validation MSE <=0.75 times zero-state validation MSE. If not, baseline incompetent and stop before OOD scoring.
gates.learned_gate_competence: All three candidate seeds must achieve validation MSE <=0.85 times zero-state; if not, report DEV_FAIL and stop OOD scoring.
gates.primary: Only if all VAL eligibility checks pass, evaluate sealed-to-this-DEV OOD once; per seed candidate OOD MSE <=0.9 times the strongest nonprivileged control (frequency, cyclic, all-write, zero) and positive 95% lower bound of 2000 paired bootstrap world resamples with seed 980401.
gates.negative: In each seed, wrong-action-credit prediction error >=1.2x correct learned gate when scored; exact midstream cold restored prediction matches continuous bitwise for fixed inputs.
gates.stop: On any source leakage, cache/baseline incompetence, nonfinite training, budget, incorrect credit, or custody error report FAIL and preserve all outcomes; no retuning to consumed OOD
gates.science: Development only; independent authenticated physical source, separately fully trained conventional models, whole-process cost and full regression mandatory for SCIENTIFIC_PASS. Synthetic success alone never qualifies.

qualification.tests: Focused deterministic source, slot-budget, no future query inputs, cold restore and negative controls
